decisions.evidence: R1 maker spec only 'derives a title when none is given'; R1 client: 'Saving a link automatically picks up its title, description, site icon, and preview image, while still letting me edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Round-1 scope omitted auto-metadata collection; client requests the reference auto-collect+editable behavior. Extend of missing reference requirements.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Warns on duplicate URLs'; R1 client: 'Saving the same address takes me to the existing bookmark to update it; it must not allow a second copy.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented 'warn' diverges from reference 'guide to edit existing'; client supplies conforming behavior.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: bookmark = URL, optional title & tags; R1 client: 'A bookmark can have an editable address, description, and note as well as its title and tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Editable address/description/note fields missing from presented scope; client extends to reference field set.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Notes should support simple formatting when displayed.' (no note/markdown in R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Markdown note render absent from presentation; client extends reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Existing tags are suggested while I type.' (absent from R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag autocomplete missing from presented scope; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker search covers 'title, address, and tags'; R1 client: 'Search covers titles, descriptions, notes, and addresses, ignores letter case, supports #tag, exact phrases, and combinations such as AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented search omits descriptions/notes, case-insensitivity, #tag, phrases, boolean/parentheses; client extends to full reference search set.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can mark links for reading later, see that list separately, and mark them read.' (absent from R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Read-later feature missing; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can archive links without deleting them, browse the archive separately, and restore them.' (absent from R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Archive/restore (distinct from delete) missing; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can select multiple links—or all links matching my current search or filter—and tag, archive, mark read/unread, or delete them together.' (absent from R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bulk actions incl. apply-to-whole-filter missing; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can sort the list, and each item clearly shows its title, description, tags, and site icon.' (R1 maker spec has no sort; list display partial)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Sort and readability-first list display (title/description/tags/favicon) missing/partial; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can save useful combinations of searches and included or excluded tags for reuse.' (absent from R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bundles/saved searches missing; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker offered decision: 'No sync / no import-export in v1 — okay to defer?'; R1 client: 'I can import and export standard browser bookmark files, so please don’t defer that.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker proposed deferring import/export (reference items); client rejects the deferral (negate). Sync deferral accepted but is not a reference item and is excluded.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can preserve a local copy of a page, with PDFs saved as PDFs, and optionally preserve it through the Internet Archive.' (absent from R1 maker spec, which excluded page-preview fetching)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Snapshot (local HTML/PDF rule) and Internet Archive missing; extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I can adjust basic display preferences such as the default sorting, number of items shown, and text size.' (absent from R1 maker spec)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Display preferences missing; extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker default #1: normalize by dropping 'trailing slash, and common tracking params (utm_*, fbclid, gclid)'; R2 client: 'Please don’t automatically remove tracking parameters or trailing slashes ... Only treat addresses as duplicates when they are safely equivalent.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Proposed over-aggressive normalization diverges from reference 'safely equivalent' dedup; client corrects to conforming rule.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker search desc lists AND/OR/NOT/parentheses but no quoted-literal rule; R2 client: 'Please also specify that words such as “AND,” “OR,” and “NOT” can be searched literally by putting them in quotes.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reference REF-BM-15 quoting-operators-as-literal rule absent from presentation; client extends. Precedence order (NOT>AND>OR) is reference-silent/orthogonal and excluded.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker import desc: Netscape 'folders→tags, with added/skipped/failed summary' (no date-added); R2 client: 'Importing must preserve each bookmark’s title, tags, and original date-added information where the file contains them.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reference REF-BM-30 preservation of title/tags/date-added underspecified in presentation; client extends. Netscape-format choice itself conforms.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Local copy (PDFs saved as PDFs)'; R2 client: 'A preserved web page should be stored as a self-contained HTML file representing the original page, not merely an extracted readable version. PDFs should continue to be stored as PDFs.'; R3 maker confirms 'not an extracted readable version'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presentation's ambiguous 'local copy' risked a readable-extract divergence from reference single-file self-contained HTML; client pins the conforming form. Borderline (underspecified presentation) but client's explicit reference expression establishes it.

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'Please ensure two tags with the same name cannot be created for this collection.' (R2 maker presentation did not state tag-name uniqueness)
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reference Tag-entity constraint (name unique within scope) missing from presentation; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker default #3: 'lightweight markdown-style ... rendered safely — not full HTML. OK?'; R2 client: 'The note formatting approach is fine.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented note-formatting conforms to reference markdown-render; recorded conforming decision (bare confirmation, not a capture).

decisions.evidence: R2 maker default #4: 'the standard Netscape bookmark HTML file used by major browsers. OK?'; R2 client: 'The standard browser bookmark HTML format is fine.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Netscape format conforms to reference import/export format; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker claims all corrections applied; R3 client: 'the edge-cases section ... still says that trailing slashes and tracking parameters are treated as duplicates. That conflicts with the corrected rule ... Please update that edge case to match the narrowed duplicate rule.'
decisions.note: Spec gate (revised presentation). Round-3 spec retained a residual dedup edge case still divergent from reference safely-equivalent rule; client catches and corrects the inconsistency. Same reference item as earlier, at a later point.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker completion report (no mention of pre-save edit); R7 client: 'the current save area only accepts an address and immediately saves it. I approved being able to review and edit the automatically collected title and description before saving ... Please add that pre-save review/edit step.'; R8 maker adds two-step fetch→review→save flow.
decisions.note: Implementation review stage. Built save flow diverged from reference REF-BM-03 (edit auto-collected title/description before saving); client supplies the expected pre-save review behavior (correct). Note: round-7 missing automated test files are orthogonal to reference functional items and excluded.
